title: al123xiaaaa/subtitle_llm
summary: 此工具利用大型语言模型（LLMs）翻译.srt字幕文件，生成包含原始文本和翻译文本的双语字幕文件。它基于Python开发，适用于字幕翻译场景。，基于模型推理的架构
description: This is a tool to translate .srt subtitle files using Large Language Models (LLMs). It generates a bilingual subtitle file containing both the original text and the translated text.
